title: Pollo a la Brasa
description: A traditional Peruvian-style roasted chicken recipe, marinated in a mixture of spices and herbs.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, blend together garlic, oregano, cumin, black pepper, and salt.
Add the chicken broth to the blender and blend until smooth.
Place the chicken in a large bowl and pour the marinade over it.
Rub the marinade all over the chicken, making sure it's well coated.
Let the chicken marinate for at least 2 hours, or overnight.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Transfer the chicken to a baking sheet and roast in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until it's cooked through and the skin is crispy.
Let the chicken rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve with warm aji amarillo pepper sauce spooned over the top.
